# Alligator of Sweden

> > Premium Swedish kitchen choppers and food preparation tools engineered for precision, durability, and efficient meal prep.

Alligator of Sweden specializes in manual food choppers, vegetable dicers, and kitchen preparation tools manufactured with stainless steel and food-safe materials. The product line includes original choppers, black edition models, multi-piece sets, and complementary tools like mandolines and graters, alongside Japanese SATAKE knives.
